source.question: is water cut on F-1 C going to keep climbing or is it levelling off?

note: Reviewed (Nov 1, new questions and synthetic field): fair, or strict at the cost of a round, not of the run.

submission.summary: F-1 C broke through to water very early and reached about 70% water cut by spring 2015. Since April the monthly averages have hovered around 62% to 71% rather than climbing steadily, but the fit suggests no clear levelling-off can yet be claimed given frequent shut-ins.

findings.claim: F-1 C water cut shifted around 2014-07-13 from an average 6% to 52%, crossing 5% in June and 50% in October 2014.
findings.detail: detect_events regime change: before_mean 0.06001 -> after_mean 0.5212 (+0.4612), across_before 0.1045 -> across_after 0.3394 change_across 0.2349; threshold 0.05 crossed 2014-06-07, threshold 0.5 crossed 2014-10-14, 6 months after first oil 2014-04-22.

findings.claim: After a late-2014 workover that added two upper perforations, water cut fell to 39% in January 2015 then climbed to 71% in April 2015 and 70% in June 2015.
findings.detail: well_operations 2014-11-27 to 2014-12-06 perforated 3733-3742.6 m and 3715-3724.6 m; production_monthly water_cut Dec 2014 0.604 (2 producing days), Jan 2015 0.3865, Mar 2015 0.6638, Apr 2015 0.7144, May 2015 0.6167, Jun 2015 0.6963; field_screen water cut 0.6938 now.

findings.claim: The rise has flattened recently: average water cut on flowing days was about 71% in April, 62% in May and 70% in June, with almost no trend over the last 90 days.
findings.detail: Agent-calculated daily means: Apr 0.7098, May 0.6191, Jun 0.7045; linear slope since January ~0.053 per month, last 90 days ~0.0011 per month (95 points since Jan, 41 in last 90). High shut-in time 84 days shut in last 180 makes monthly averages volatile.

findings.claim: No stable WOR trend can be fitted yet — only 8 months had water cut above 50% — and the well held higher liquid by opening the choke.
findings.detail: waterflood wor_fit null, need 12 months with WOR>=1 have 8; water cut 0.5 is threshold for WOR>=1 per no_trend text; by_year liquid 665.82 Sm3/d in 2014 at 48.77% choke water cut 0.3939 vs 1185 Sm3/d in 2015 at 53.71% choke water cut 0.6403; field voidage replacement ~1.02 in 2014 and 0.9945 in 2015 (reservoir, surface ratio 1.11/1.13). No PLT log for F-1 C.

issues.text: oil rate per producing day down 30% over the last 90 days (489 -> 341 Sm3/d)
84 days shut in over the last 180
downhole pressure gauge reads 0 (1650 days, 1,005,913 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data): a monitoring gap, the well flows on
oil rate dropped 61% across the change (4 weeks each side, 1,045 -> 411 Sm3/d); the choke was cut at the same time (11 -> 5%)
oil rate 40% lower in the period after than before (weekly mean 237 -> 142 Sm3/d), a gradual change: 19% across it

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.summary: 30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2014-06-07, 2 months after first oil.
water_cut shifts around 2014-07-13: weekly mean 0.06 -> 0.521 (+0.46) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 0.10 -> 0.34 (+0.23).
Shut in for 13 days from 2014-08-20. Oil rate 459 -> 354 Sm3/d (-23%) after restart. Same time as F-15 D; F-11, F-12, F-14 kept flowing.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.5 on 2014-10-14, 6 months after first oil.
Shut in for 26 days from 2014-12-06. Oil rate 290 -> 574 Sm3/d (+98%) after restart. Same time as F-12, F-15 D; F-11, F-14 kept flowing.
Shut in for 7 days from 2015-01-22. Oil rate 574 -> 475 Sm3/d (-17%) after restart.
Shut in for 9 days from 2015-01-31. Oil rate 574 -> 475 Sm3/d (-17%) after restart.

result.no_trend: too few months with WOR >= 1 (water cut 0.5) to fit a trend: 8, need 12
result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. The water cuts in to_limits are reference points, not an economic limit: the data holds no costs or prices, so remaining_oil_sm3 says how much oil is left before each, not whether it pays. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

summaries.summary: Drilled 17 1/2" hole from 1364 m to 1482 m. Circulated bottoms up. Perform check trip to 10 m inside 20" shoe. Drilled 17 1/2" hole to 1502 m.

Drilled 17 1/2" hole from 1502 m to 1540 m. WOW circulated well clean. POOH with 17 1/2" BHA to inside 20" shoe. Performed general service on drilling equipment while WOW. RIH with 17 1/2" BHA to 1540 m. Drilled 17 1/2" hole to 1660 m.

Drilled 17 1/2" hole from 1660 m to 1684 m. Waited one weather, not able to discharge cuttings to vessel due to bad weather. Circulated well clean. POOH with 17 1/2" BHA on 5 1/2" DP to inside 20" shoe. Performed general rig service and PM on drilling equipment.

Correlated and perforated interval #12 (3579 - 3588 m). POOH, inflow tested HMV and SV. L/D tool string #12. M/U perforation assy #13 (3545 - 3554 m). RIH, correlated and perforated interval #13. POOH, inflow tested HMV and SV. L/D tool string #13.

R/D wireline lubricator, riser and BOP. Installed permanent hatch on F-1 slot. Installed XMT cap and R/U for pressure and inflow testing. P/T tree cap, SV, KWV to 35/345 bar. Inflow tested DHSV, HMV, MMV. R/D hose and manifold from KWV. Installed KWV cap.
P/T kill wing cap to 35/345 bar 5/15 min. Well F-1 C handed over to production at 01:30 hrs.
Well handed over from production department to D&W. Started to rig up WL equipment on well.
Completetd rigging up WL equipment. Installed tractor & PLT/RST toolstring. Performed Sigma pass from 3949-3480 m. Logged IC pass from 3785 to 3660 m.
Logged three IC passes and started additional PLT shut in passes.
Completed additional PLT shut in passes. Attempted to bean up well without success. Waiting for well to flow.
Waited for well to flow. Decided to POOH with PLT/RST. Made up perforation BHA and installed same into lubricator.

Installed long perfoartion guns. Had to POOH with long perforation guns due to tension above 50% of cable strength 150 above shooting depth. Decision made to split the perforation guns. RIH with shorter perforation gun.
RIH with short perforation guns and perforated zone from 3733 to 3742,6 m. POOH with BHA#3. RIH with second short perforation gun.

RIH with tractor and perforated . POOH to surface and L/D BHA#4. All shots fired. Observed Bird nest of cable on top of cable head, and wire strands inside tool catcher. Started to flow well. Got production shut down and well was closed in. Started to flow well, seams to stabilize at high rate.
Flowed well to stabilize pressure and rate. Decided to R/D WL equipment. Production closed in well. Inflow tested HMV and DHSV. R/D WL equipment.
R/D WL equipment. Leak tested XT-tree valves. Handed well over OM. Prepared WL equipment for backload. Finished demobilize. End of operation

result.note: Daily reports exist for drilling and for work on the well (wireline, plugs, perforations, production logs), not for days of normal production. A job's date is the day the work was done; kind is drilling, completion, workover (work on a producing or injecting well) or abandonment. Ask for one day to see every operation line.

arguments.sql: SELECT date, oil_sm3, water_sm3, water_cut, choke_pct, on_stream_hrs FROM production_daily WHERE well='F-1 C' ORDER BY date

arguments.purpose: Compute water cut trend slope for F-1 C corrected
arguments.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = sql("SELECT date, water_cut, oil_sm3, water_sm3, choke_pct, on_stream_hrs FROM production_daily WHERE well='F-1 C' AND water_cut IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date")
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
recent = df[df['date'] >= '2015-01-01']
x = (recent['date'] - recent['date'].min()).dt.days.values
y = recent['water_cut'].values
m,c = np.linalg.lstsq(np.vstack([x, np.ones(len(x))]).T, y, rcond=None)[0]
slope_per_month = m*30
last90 = df[df['date'] >= '2015-04-01']
x2 = (last90['date'] - last90['date'].min()).dt.days.values
y2 = last90['water_cut'].values
if len(x2)>1:
    m2,c2 = np.linalg.lstsq(np.vstack([x2, np.ones(len(x2))]).T, y2, rcond=None)[0]
else:
    m2=0
# monthly means from production_monthly already known, but compute from df monthly
df['ym'] = df['date'].dt.to_period('M').astype(str)
monthly = df.groupby('ym')['water_cut'].mean().reset_index()
result = {
    "slope_since_Jan_per_month": float(slope_per_month),
    "slope_last90_per_month": float(m2*30),
    "mean_wc_June": float(df[df['ym']=='2015-06']['water_cut'].mean()),
    "mean_wc_May": float(df[df['ym']=='2015-05']['water_cut'].mean()),
    "mean_wc_Apr": float(df[df['ym']=='2015-04']['water_cut'].mean()),
    "mean_wc_Mar": float(df[df['ym']=='2015-03']['water_cut'].mean()),
    "monthly_means": monthly.tail(8).to_dict(orient="records"),
    "n_points_recent": len(recent),
    "n_points_last90": len(last90)
}
result
